headline: Cosmetology: Hair & Nails Foundation
threshold: Use Spanish to complete the Cosmetology: Hair & Nails situations, ask for clarification, and confirm a shared plan.

lessons.title: Welcome to the salon
lessons.objective: Greet a client, introduce your role, and confirm their appointment.
lessons.focus: Use ser for identity and descriptions; estar for location or current state. Spanish subject pronouns are often optional.

words.en: Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Greet a client, introduce your role, and confirm their appointment. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: Hola, tengo una cita para las uñas. ¿Con quién hablo?
lessons.partnerRole: a client arriving at the salon

lessons.title: Find the hair and nail stations
lessons.objective: Locate the main stations and ask where equipment belongs.
lessons.focus: Hay means there is or there are. Use está/están to locate a specific person or item.

words.en: Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Locate the main stations and ask where equipment belongs. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: ¿Me muestras dónde están la mesa de uñas y el lavabo?
lessons.partnerRole: a salon client, classmate, or salon mentor

lessons.title: Talk about hair
lessons.objective: Describe hair texture and ask about the desired length.
lessons.focus: Tener expresses possession. Tener + noun is also used in expressions such as tener una duda.

words.en: Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Describe hair texture and ask about the desired length. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: Cuéntame cómo es tu cabello y qué largo quieres.
lessons.partnerRole: a salon client, classmate, or salon mentor

lessons.title: Talk about hands and nails
lessons.objective: Name hand and nail parts and confirm a shape preference.
lessons.focus: Estar describes a current state or location. It agrees with the subject: está for one, están for more than one.

words.en: Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Name hand and nail parts and confirm a shape preference. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: ¿Quieres cambiar la forma o el largo de tus uñas?
lessons.partnerRole: a salon client, classmate, or salon mentor

lessons.title: Choose colors
lessons.objective: Choose a shade, compare samples, and ask for another option.
lessons.focus: Me gusta is used with one thing or an activity; me gustan with plural things. The thing liked determines the verb.

words.en: Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Choose a shade, compare samples, and ask for another option. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: Aquí tienes las muestras. ¿Qué color te gusta más?
lessons.partnerRole: a salon client, classmate, or salon mentor

lessons.title: Name everyday hair tools
lessons.objective: Identify a tool and request it clearly from a classmate.
lessons.focus: Necesitar can be followed by a noun or an infinitive. The second verb stays in its dictionary form.

words.en: Can you pass me the towel?
Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Identify a tool and request it clearly from a classmate. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: Estamos preparando la estación. ¿Qué herramienta necesitas?

lessons.title: Name everyday nail tools
lessons.objective: Locate nail tools and distinguish a base coat from a finish.
lessons.focus: Hay means there is or there are. Use está/están to locate a specific person or item.

words.en: Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Locate nail tools and distinguish a base coat from a finish. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: ¿Qué quieres poner en la bandeja antes de empezar?
lessons.partnerRole: a salon client, classmate, or salon mentor

lessons.title: Ask what the client wants
lessons.objective: Ask open questions and confirm a client’s preference before choosing a service.
lessons.focus: Querer + noun or infinitive expresses a preference. Me gustaría makes a softer request; clarify rather than assume.

words.en: What would you like to change?
Can you show me a photo?
Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Ask open questions and confirm a client’s preference before choosing a service. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: Tengo una idea, pero no sé cómo explicarla. ¿Me ayudas?
lessons.partnerRole: a client describing a new look

lessons.title: Appointment times and prices
lessons.objective: Ask for a price and confirm appointment time without assuming a real salon’s rates.
lessons.focus: Use cuánto for how much, cuántos for how many masculine items, and a qué hora for at what time.

words.en: Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Ask for a price and confirm appointment time without assuming a real salon’s rates. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: Tengo tiempo mañana por la tarde. ¿A qué hora me puedes atender?
lessons.partnerRole: a salon client, classmate, or salon mentor

lessons.title: Keep the consultation comfortable
lessons.objective: Ask permission, invite a comfort check, and pass a product concern to the instructor.
lessons.focus: Poder + infinitive expresses ability or a request. Puedo, puedes and puede change o to ue; podemos keeps o.

words.en: Let me know if you need a break.
Can you repeat it more slowly?
I want to confirm that I understood.

lessons.speaking: Ask permission, invite a comfort check, and pass a product concern to the instructor. Speak in Spanish; ask for help or slower speech when needed. End by confirming the agreed next step.
lessons.openingLine: Antes de empezar, ¿qué quieres preguntarme sobre el producto?
lessons.partnerRole: a salon client, classmate, or salon mentor
